description: An empty tuple for a list of the dynamic pseudo-type becomes an empty list of that type
notes: The dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, and in a type specification it stands for any type, so no value should have it as a list's element type. The spec's call rules also make an empty tuple, which doesn't match a list of the dynamic pseudo-type, an error. hashicorp/hcl converts arguments to their parameter's type with go-cty's convert.Convert (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), which returns an empty list of the requested element type for an empty tuple (conversionTupleToList in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go).
